old_problem: Title requires QD1 while the source job uses iodepth64; workload identity and matching thresholds are therefore undefined, in addition to destructive runtime bindings.
disposition_reason: Queue depth materially changes coverage, performance and write stress. ED-19/20 prohibit silently normalizing the job to the title as DeepSeek did. Parameterization can bind target and thresholds, but it cannot choose between contradictory authoritative profiles; engineering must select one or split them into independently identified variants.
decision_basis: Directly read Performance row11 all18 XLSX cells and history2588.
Preserved literal title QD1 and literal job `iodepth=64` plus the full43200-second destructive write.
Defined safe target/range, endurance, thermal and recovery gates without using them to conceal the unresolved workload identity.
No fio installation, write or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: M.2 sequential-write512B authoritative queue-depth decision and safe validation
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved M.2 sequential-write profile after QD1 versus QD64 is authoritatively selected or split, without risking protected data.
required_package: Decision selecting QD1 or QD64, or two distinct variant IDs and threshold matrices
Signed empty M.2 namespace/range, serial/path ownership and write/endurance budget
Approved fio artifact, preconditioning, cache/power and PCIe topology
Full43200-second authorization with thermal/SMART/AER abort limits
Depth-specific IOPS/BW/latency thresholds and restore plan
test_case.test_command: Do not run while the queue-depth conflict remains. After authority selects/splits the profile, verify offline empty serial/namespace/path and bounded offset/size, hash the exact job preserving write/512B/numjobs1/10s ramp/43200s plus the approved depth, run once with full output and telemetry, and restore/reprovision the target.
test_case.expected_result: The explicitly approved depth variant completes within its bounded range/write budget, remains healthy and meets its matching depth-specific thresholds; restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an authoritative depth identity before execution, exact achieved depth/duration, safe target, complete evidence, healthy media and matching thresholds. Choosing a depth implicitly or comparing QD64 to QD1 limits is invalid.
safety_gate: No execution until QD conflict is resolved or split.
Fail closed on OS/mount/RAID/LVM/data ownership or serial/path mismatch.
Bound offset/size and write budget; monitor thermal/SMART/AER.
No shortened substitute or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Signed QD decision or separate variant identities
Exact hashed job and full43200-second output
test_case.recovery: On path mismatch, budget/thermal/health breach or restore failure, stop without retry, preserve evidence, isolate the device and perform only the approved reformat/reprovision/recovery procedure.
